inputs.label: Resident Evil Code: Veronica X PS2 disc image (NTSC-U, SLUS-20184)
inputs.help: Your own .iso of the PS2 version, NTSC-U, SLUS-20184.

steps.why: The guide has the user allow access to all files on the first launch, to read the disc image.

steps.text: Open the app from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it. In the launcher choose Disc, pick your .iso, then Play. In Settings, use 2x resolution on Quest 2 and 3x on Quest 3.

notes: Asset names vary between releases (v1.5.0 used RE-Code-Veronica-X-Quest-VR-, v1.5.1 RE-Code-Veronica-X-VR-); the pattern takes both and skips the Windows zip. The optional HD texture pack is not modelled. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
